title: November’s Night Sky Notes: Light-Day Away
caption:
Voyager 1, launched in 1977, will be a full light‑day from the Sun in November 2026—about 16 billion miles away. That makes it the most distant human‑made object, still bearing Earth’s sounds for the cosmos.

Source: Science - November’s Night Sky Notes: Light-Day Away

https://science.nasa.gov/solar-system/skywatching/night-sky-network/novembers-night-sky-notes-light-day-away/
